mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM( CASE WHEN direction = 1 THEN amount WHEN direction = 2 THEN -amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) FROM referral_commission WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT rc.title AS userName, '' AS avatar, rc.amount AS amount FROM referral_commission rc WHERE rc.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY rc.create_time DESC

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(u.user_name), ''), u.phone) AS userName, IFNULL(u.avatar, '') AS avatar, IFNULL(inv.invite_count, 0) AS inviteCount, IFNULL(comm.amount, 0) AS amount FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT inviter.invitation_code, COUNT(1) AS invite_count FROM tb_user inviter INNER JOIN tb_user invitee ON invitee.superior_invitation_code = inviter.invitation_code WHERE inviter.invitation_code IS NOT NULL AND inviter.invitation_code != '' GROUP BY inviter.invitation_code ) inv ON inv.invitation_code = u.invitation_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, SUM( CASE WHEN direction = 1 THEN amount WHEN direction = 2 THEN -amount ELSE 0 END ) AS amount FROM referral_commission GROUP BY user_id ) comm ON comm.user_id = u.user_id WHERE IFNULL(comm.amount, 0) > 0 OR IFNULL(inv.invite_count, 0) > 0 ORDER BY amount DESC, inviteCount DESC, u.user_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
